content: Kini vekamo Sekisiꞌe Motekaiꞌeꞌmo ala anakiꞌanimo haneꞌniya kavafeꞌmo anava gemae
Kini vekamo Sekisiꞌa muki yagaino neꞌapateya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, Takesi monimo alitapa namiyo, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌa aliꞌa amiꞌnae.

Kini vekamoꞌa Motekaiꞌmo alopa napamo alino amiꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo muki lokiya kavanagi himamuꞌaletiꞌmo huꞌniya kavanagi huno huteno muki ani kavatefeꞌmo Pesiya vayaꞌaiteꞌe Mitiya vayaꞌaiteꞌeꞌmo neꞌyagaiya kini vayaꞌai mukuꞌapifiꞌmo avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnae.

Inagi Yu vekamo Motekaiꞌa kini vekamo Sekisi napa tuꞌamo maiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo Yu vayaꞌmogimo ala agiꞌamo amiteꞌa muki konagaꞌamogimo amuse huꞌa ateꞌnae. Ateꞌnageno alagepa aliꞌyaꞌmo aliteno Yu vayaꞌmo hapa maeteno alagepa huꞌa maisayafeꞌmo ge lagauno apateno maiꞌniye.
